top.sql: INSERT INTO "owner_1".events(id,schema_version,type,namespace,payload,metadata,correlation_id,created_at) SELECT 'synthetic-event-'||i,7, CASE WHEN i%10=2 THEN 'copilotz.server.action.requested' ELSE 'synthetic.history' END, 'archive',CASE WHEN i<$2 THEN jsonb_build_object('dataRef',jsonb_build_object('eventBodyId','synthetic-body-'||i,'schemaVersion',1,'mediaType','application/json')) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END, jsonb_build_object('sourceEventId','synthetic-event-'||(i-i%10+2)),'synthetic-correlation-'||i,$3::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i
INSERT INTO "owner_1".event_bodies SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::"owner_1".event_bodies,$1::jsonb)

INSERT INTO "owner_1".event_deliveries(id,event_id,consumer_id,settlement_scope_id,status,attempts,created_at,updated_at,settled_at) SELECT 'synthetic-delivery-'||i,'synthetic-event-'||i,'synthetic.consumer','synthetic-event-'||i,'succeeded',1,$2::timestamptz,$2::timestamptz,$2::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i

INSERT INTO "owner_1".nodes(id,namespace,type,name,data,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'synthetic-asset-'||i,'archive','asset','asset-'||i, jsonb_build_object('state','ready','byteLength',$2::integer,'digest',$3::text, 'location',jsonb_build_object('kind','database','backendId','database:default','key','synthetic-physical-'||i), 'origin',jsonb_build_object('id','synthetic-document-'||i,'type','synthetic_document')), $4::timestamptz,$4::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i
ANALYZE "owner_1"."events"

INSERT INTO "owner_1".content_body_parts(body_id,start_offset,append_id,bytes,created_at) SELECT 'synthetic-physical-'||i,0,'synthetic-put',$2::bytea,$3::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i
ANALYZE "owner_1"."event_bodies"

INSERT INTO "owner_1".edges(id,namespace,source_node_id,target_node_id,type,data,created_at) SELECT 'synthetic-edge-'||i,'archive','synthetic-owner-'||i,'synthetic-asset-'||i,'has_asset','{}',$2::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i

INSERT INTO "owner_1".nodes(id,namespace,type,name,data,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'synthetic-owner-'||i,'archive','@copilotz/action-content','owner-'||i, jsonb_build_object('assetIds',jsonb_build_array('synthetic-asset-'||i)), $2::timestamptz,$2::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i

INSERT INTO "owner_1".nodes(id,namespace,type,name,data,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'synthetic-document-'||i,'archive','synthetic_document','document-'||i, jsonb_build_object('assetId','synthetic-asset-'||i),$2::timestamptz,$2::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i
ANALYZE "owner_1"."nodes"

INSERT INTO "owner_1".content_bodies(body_id,state,media_type,byte_length,digest,maintenance_version,created_at,updated_at,ready_at) SELECT 'synthetic-physical-'||i,'ready','application/octet-stream',$2,$3,1,$4::timestamptz,$4::timestamptz,$4::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i
ANALYZE "owner_1"."event_deliveries"

INSERT INTO "owner_1".nodes(id,namespace,type,name,data,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'synthetic-session-'||i,'archive','synthetic_session','session-'||i, jsonb_build_object('principal','synthetic-principal-'||i,'expiresAt','2030-01-01T00:00:00Z'), $2::timestamptz,$2::timestamptz FROM generate_series(0,$1::integer-1) i
ANALYZE "owner_1"."edges"
SELECT "status" AS state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" GROUP BY "status"
SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = $1 AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
SELECT "state" AS state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" GROUP BY "state"
SELECT "state" AS state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operation_streams" GROUP BY "state"
SELECT "state" AS state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operations" GROUP BY "state"
SELECT "state" AS state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "owner_1"."open_actions" GROUP BY "state"
SELECT version FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_schema_metadata" WHERE singleton
SELECT namespace, event_body_id, schema_version, body, digest, created_at FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" WHERE namespace = $1 AND event_body_id = $2 LIMIT 1

SELECT body.*, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('appendId',part.append_id,'offset',part.start_offset,'length',octet_length(part.bytes),'digest',part.part_digest) ORDER BY part.start_offset) FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" part WHERE part.body_id=body.body_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS parts FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" body WHERE body.body_id=$1

SELECT part.* FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" body LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( WITH anchor AS (SELECT start_offset FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" WHERE body_id=body.body_id AND start_offset<=$2 ORDER BY start_offset DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT start_offset,octet_length(bytes) AS part_length, substring(bytes FROM (GREATEST($2::bigint-start_offset,0)+1)::integer FOR (LEAST($3::bigint-start_offset,octet_length(bytes))-GREATEST($2::bigint-start_offset,0))::integer) AS bytes FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" WHERE body_id=body.body_id AND $3::bigint>$2::bigint AND start_offset>=COALESCE((SELECT start_offset FROM anchor),$2::bigint) AND start_offset<$3::bigint ORDER BY start_offset ) part ON TRUE WHERE body.body_id=$1 AND body.reservation_id=$4 AND COALESCE(body.fenced_from,body.writer_generation)=$5 AND body.byte_length>=$3 AND body.state<>'aborted' ORDER BY part.start_offset

SELECT invoked.event_body_id FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" invoked WHERE invoked.body->>'status'='invoked' AND invoked.body->>'actionRunId' IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" terminal WHERE terminal.namespace=invoked.namespace AND terminal.body->>'actionRunId'=invoked.body->>'actionRunId' AND terminal.body->>'actionId'=invoked.body->>'actionId' AND terminal.body->>'status' IN ('completed','failed','cancelled')) LIMIT 1

UPDATE "owner_1"."content_bodies" SET reservation_id=$2,writer_generation=COALESCE(writer_generation,1),version_token=$3,maintenance_version=GREATEST(maintenance_version,1),digest=CASE WHEN state='aborted' THEN NULL ELSE digest END WHERE body_id=$1
INSERT INTO "owner_1"."content_body_parts"(body_id,start_offset,append_id,bytes,part_digest) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)
SELECT id,position,namespace,payload->'dataRef' AS ref FROM "owner_1"."events" WHERE position>$1::bigint AND payload ? 'dataRef' ORDER BY position LIMIT 250
SELECT namespace,event_body_id,body FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies"
SELECT id, namespace, type, name, data FROM "owner_1"."nodes" ORDER BY namespace, id
SELECT body_id,bytes,start_offset FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" ORDER BY body_id,start_offset
SELECT namespace,id,data FROM "owner_1"."nodes"

ALTER TABLE "owner_1"."content_bodies" ADD CONSTRAINT body_state CHECK(state IN ('open','ready','incomplete','aborted')), ADD CONSTRAINT body_generation CHECK(writer_generation>=1 AND writer_generation<=9007199254740991), ADD CONSTRAINT body_fenced CHECK(fenced_from IS NULL OR (fenced_from>=1 AND fenced_from=writer_generation-1)), ADD CONSTRAINT body_length CHECK(byte_length>=0 AND byte_length<=9007199254740991), ADD CONSTRAINT body_revision CHECK(maintenance_version>=1), ADD CONSTRAINT body_digest CHECK((state IN ('ready','incomplete') AND digest IS NOT NULL AND digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$') OR (state IN ('open','aborted') AND digest IS NULL))

ALTER TABLE "owner_1"."content_body_parts" ADD CONSTRAINT body_offset CHECK(start_offset>=0 AND start_offset<=9007199254740991), ADD CONSTRAINT body_part_length CHECK(octet_length(bytes)>=1 AND octet_length(bytes)<=1048576), ADD CONSTRAINT body_part_digest CHECK(part_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$')
SELECT body_id,state,byte_length,digest FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies"

SELECT 'causation' AS kind, event.id FROM "owner_1"."events" event LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" parent ON parent.id=event.causation_id AND parent.namespace=event.namespace WHERE event.causation_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'graph namespace', edge.id FROM "owner_1"."edges" edge LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."nodes" source ON source.namespace=edge.namespace AND source.id=edge.source_node_id LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."nodes" target ON target.namespace=edge.namespace AND target.id=edge.target_node_id WHERE source.id IS NULL OR target.id IS NULL OR source.namespace<>edge.namespace OR target.namespace<>edge.namespace UNION ALL SELECT 'delivery', delivery.id FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" delivery LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=delivery.event_id WHERE event.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'operation event', indexed.event_id FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operation_events" indexed LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=indexed.event_id AND event.namespace=indexed.namespace WHERE event.id IS NULL OR event.position<>indexed.event_position UNION ALL SELECT 'operation root', operation.operation_id FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operations" operation LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=operation.root_event_id AND event.namespace=operation.namespace WHERE event.id IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT namespace, event_body_id, schema_version, body, digest, created_at FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" WHERE namespace = $1 AND event_body_id = $2 LIMIT 1
WITH numbered AS (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY position) AS seq FROM "owner_1"."events") UPDATE "owner_1"."events" AS event SET seq=numbered.seq FROM numbered WHERE event.id=numbered.id

SELECT invoked.event_body_id FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" invoked WHERE invoked.body->>'status'='invoked' AND invoked.body->>'actionRunId' IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" terminal WHERE terminal.namespace=invoked.namespace AND terminal.body->>'actionRunId'=invoked.body->>'actionRunId' AND terminal.body->>'actionId'=invoked.body->>'actionId' AND terminal.body->>'status' IN ('completed','failed','cancelled')) LIMIT 1

SELECT body.*, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('appendId',part.append_id,'offset',part.start_offset,'length',octet_length(part.bytes),'digest',part.part_digest) ORDER BY part.start_offset) FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" part WHERE part.body_id=body.body_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS parts FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" body WHERE body.body_id=$1

SELECT part.* FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" body LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( WITH anchor AS (SELECT start_offset FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" WHERE body_id=body.body_id AND start_offset<=$2 ORDER BY start_offset DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT start_offset,octet_length(bytes) AS part_length, substring(bytes FROM (GREATEST($2::bigint-start_offset,0)+1)::integer FOR (LEAST($3::bigint-start_offset,octet_length(bytes))-GREATEST($2::bigint-start_offset,0))::integer) AS bytes FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" WHERE body_id=body.body_id AND $3::bigint>$2::bigint AND start_offset>=COALESCE((SELECT start_offset FROM anchor),$2::bigint) AND start_offset<$3::bigint ORDER BY start_offset ) part ON TRUE WHERE body.body_id=$1 AND body.reservation_id=$4 AND COALESCE(body.fenced_from,body.writer_generation)=$5 AND body.byte_length>=$3 AND body.state<>'aborted' ORDER BY part.start_offset
UPDATE "owner_1"."nodes" SET data=$3::jsonb WHERE namespace=$1 AND id=$2 AND data=$4::jsonb RETURNING id
INSERT INTO "owner_1"."edges" (id, namespace, source_node_id, target_node_id, type, data) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'has_asset','{}'::jsonb)

INSERT INTO "owner_1"."content_logical_bodies"(body_id,namespace,current_copy,writer_id,generation,revocation,protected_until,committed_offset,seal_intent,terminal) VALUES($1,$2,$3,'offline-migration',1,'revoked',NOW(),$4,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(body_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO "owner_1"."content_copies"(copy_key,backend_kind,backend_id,body_id,version_token,state,collectable) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'current',$6) ON CONFLICT(copy_key) DO NOTHING
SELECT body_id,version_token FROM "owner_1"."content_copies" WHERE copy_key=$1
SELECT id,position,namespace,payload->'dataRef' AS ref FROM "owner_1"."events" WHERE position>$1::bigint AND payload ? 'dataRef' ORDER BY position LIMIT 250
SELECT id, namespace, type, name, data FROM "owner_1"."nodes" ORDER BY namespace, id
SELECT namespace,event_body_id,body FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies"

SELECT 'causation' AS kind, event.id FROM "owner_1"."events" event LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" parent ON parent.id=event.causation_id AND parent.namespace=event.namespace WHERE event.causation_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'graph namespace', edge.id FROM "owner_1"."edges" edge LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."nodes" source ON source.namespace=edge.namespace AND source.id=edge.source_node_id LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."nodes" target ON target.namespace=edge.namespace AND target.id=edge.target_node_id WHERE source.id IS NULL OR target.id IS NULL OR source.namespace<>edge.namespace OR target.namespace<>edge.namespace UNION ALL SELECT 'delivery', delivery.id FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" delivery LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=delivery.event_id WHERE event.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'operation event', indexed.event_id FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operation_events" indexed LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=indexed.event_id AND event.namespace=indexed.namespace WHERE event.id IS NULL OR event.position<>indexed.event_position UNION ALL SELECT 'operation root', operation.operation_id FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operations" operation LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=operation.root_event_id AND event.namespace=operation.namespace WHERE event.id IS NULL LIMIT 1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_owner_seq_idx ON "owner_1"."events" (seq)
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"delta" AS value FROM "owner_1"."events"
SELECT start_offset,encode(bytes,'base64') AS bytes,part_digest FROM "owner_1"."content_body_parts" WHERE body_id=$1 ORDER BY start_offset
SELECT media_type,byte_length FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" WHERE body_id=$1 AND state IN ('ready','incomplete')
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"payload" AS value FROM "owner_1"."events"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"body" AS value,namespace FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"metadata" AS value FROM "owner_1"."events"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"owner_ingress" AS value FROM "owner_1"."events"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"data" AS value FROM "owner_1"."nodes"

SELECT b.body_id,b.namespace,b.current_copy,b.terminal,c.backend_kind,c.backend_id FROM "owner_1"."content_logical_bodies" b JOIN "owner_1"."content_copies" c ON c.copy_key=b.current_copy WHERE c.state='current' ORDER BY b.body_id
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"last_error" AS value FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"terminal" AS value FROM "owner_1"."content_logical_bodies"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"seal_intent" AS value FROM "owner_1"."content_logical_bodies"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"data" AS value FROM "owner_1"."edges"
SELECT "state" AS state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "owner_1"."content_bodies" GROUP BY "state"
SELECT ctid::text AS tid,"promotion_target" AS value FROM "owner_1"."content_logical_bodies"

SELECT e.namespace,e.id,e.metadata,e.payload,e.owner_ingress,b.body,b.digest,b.schema_version FROM "owner_1"."events" e LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."event_bodies" b ON b.namespace=e.namespace AND b.event_body_id=e.payload->'dataRef'->>'eventBodyId' WHERE COALESCE(b.body->'data',b.body)->>'status'='invoked' OR NULLIF(e.owner_ingress,'null'::jsonb) IS NOT NULL OR e.type IN ('copilotz.server.action.requested','copilotz.server.collection.mutation.requested') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" d WHERE d.event_id=e.id AND d.status IN ('pending','leased','retry_wait')) ORDER BY e.namespace,e.id
SELECT key,intent,result FROM "owner_1"."owner_receipts" WHERE owner='schema' AND domain='logical' AND kind='action.protected-input'

WITH active AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" WHERE status IN ('pending','leased','retry_wait') ) SELECT e.namespace,e.id,e.metadata,e.payload,e.owner_ingress,b.body,b.digest,b.schema_version FROM "owner_1"."events" e LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."event_bodies" b ON b.namespace=e.namespace AND b.event_body_id=e.payload->'dataRef'->>'eventBodyId' LEFT JOIN active ON active.event_id=e.id WHERE COALESCE(b.body->'data',b.body)->>'status'='invoked' OR NULLIF(e.owner_ingress,'null'::jsonb) IS NOT NULL OR e.type IN ('copilotz.server.action.requested','copilotz.server.collection.mutation.requested') OR active.event_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.namespace,e.id
SELECT key,intent,result FROM "owner_1"."owner_receipts" WHERE owner='schema' AND domain='logical' AND kind='action.protected-input'
